description:
You are a network architect conducting a baseline security audit of a network segment. A combined packet capture containing traffic from multiple protocols has been prepared at /home/ga/Documents/captures/baseline_audit.pcapng. This capture merges traffic from different sources to represent a typical network segment's activity.

Analyze the capture and produce a comprehensive baseline audit report at /home/ga/Documents/captures/baseline_audit_report.txt containing:

1. All unique protocols observed in the capture (list each protocol name)
2. All unique IP addresses that appear as endpoints (both source and destination)
3. All unique destination TCP/UDP ports contacted
4. The number of TCP retransmissions observed (if any)
5. The total packet count and total bytes transferred in the capture

Each section should be clearly labeled. This report will serve as the baseline for future anomaly detection.

Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
